title: Bicycle Kinematic Model
text: Compute car-like vehicle motion using bicycle kinematic model, 3 inputs, 2 outputs; {Vehicle inputs} sets the type of speed and directional inputs for vehicle Vehicle Speed & Steering, {Wheel base} sets the distance between front and rear axles, {Vehicle speed range} sets the minimum and maximum vehicle speeds, {Maximum steering angle} sets the max turning radius, {Initial state} sets the initial pose of vehicle and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: stateDot
ports.summary: Derivatives of state output three-element vector

params.name: Vehicle inputs
params.values: Type of speed and directional inputs for vehicle Vehicle Speed & Steering Angle (default) | Vehicle Speed & Heading Angular Velocity

params.name: Wheel base
params.values: Distance between front and rear axles 1 (default) | positive numeric scalar

params.name: Vehicle speed range
params.values: Minimum and maximum vehicle speeds [-Inf Inf] (default) | two-element vector

params.name: Maximum steering angle
params.values: Max turning radius pi/4 (default) | numeric scalar

params.name: Initial state
params.values: Initial pose of vehicle [0;0;0] (default) | three-element vector

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
